zh.title: 以色列同意 flydubai 恢復特拉維夫航班，仍待安全審查
zh.summary: 以色列交通部長同意 flydubai 恢復杜拜至特拉維夫航線，復飛仍須取得以色列安全機關批准，日期尚未公布。
body: 以色列交通部長米里・雷格夫（Miri Regev）同意 flydubai 恢復從杜拜飛往特拉維夫的航班。以色列交通部向路透社表示，復飛仍以安全機關核准為前提。航空公司表示正與有關機關協調。
以色列代表團赴杜拜與阿聯航空主管機關討論安全措施後，交通部作出這項決定。flydubai 在 9 月 30 日一班特拉維夫航班因機上安全事件轉降後，暫停這條航線。

en.title: Israel approves resuming flydubai’s Tel Aviv flights pending security clearance
en.summary: Israel’s transport minister approved resuming flydubai flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv, subject to clearance by Israeli security authorities. A restart date has yet to be announced.
body: Israeli Transport Minister Miri Regev approved flydubai resuming service from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Israel’s transport ministry told Reuters that the restart remained subject to security clearance. The airline said it was working with the relevant authorities.

The decision followed talks between Israeli officials and Emirati aviation authorities in Dubai over security measures. flydubai suspended the route after a Tel Aviv-bound flight diverted on Sept. 30 following an onboard security incident.

facts.claim: Regev approved flydubai’s return to Tel Aviv subject to security clearance, and the airline said it was working with the authorities.
The approval followed talks in Dubai and the route had been suspended following a Sept. 30 onboard security incident.
